name: Halloween Costumes
tagline: Classic, clever and spooky costumes, all in good fun.
description: Twelve-plus costume ideas without buying a single costume: gothic vampire, storybook witch, scarecrow, astronaut, wizard, pirate captain, mad scientist, haunted Victorian, classic monster, jazz-age detective, woodland fairy-tale and old-west cowboy. Spooky fun, never gruesome, with your face always visible.
